description: Search a parts list harvested from the annotated features of the vector library — promoters, terminators, RBSs, polyA signals, origins, selection markers, affinity tags, reporters, linkers/MCSs — by name, kind or length. Nothing here is transcribed: every part is the exact sequence a GenBank record annotated, and each hit carries the accession and 1-based span it was cut from, plus every other library vector the same part was found in. Parts whose location is spliced or approximate are excluded, because their sequence is not fully determined.

includeSequence.description: Include each part's bases (5'→3' on the part's own strand).

kinds.description: Restrict to these part kinds (promoter, terminator, origin, RBS, polyA, selection marker, affinity tag, reporter, linker/MCS, …). An unknown kind is an error.

limit.description: Maximum hits to return. Capped at 100; asking for more is an error, not a silent truncation.

query.description: Substring of the part name (min 2 characters), e.g. "T7", "AmpR", "SV40 polyA".

name: parts_library_search
title: Search the parts library
